description: Specialized in desktop software development and embedded systems:
Developed a patient monitoring application as a part of medical device
- The capstone course consists of two parts; the thesis/design is done in the first winter semester of the senior year,
while the thesis and the designed project are developed in the spring semester.
- In the thesis/design part, I designed a medical device, and in the project part, I implemented a part of this design.
- The device I designed is a bedside monitor device. In the development phase, I developed the main application of this device
and created a project that works with simulation data. In the design part, the idea is making more feasible, modular, extensible, and easy-to-change hardware.
- The aim of the project is to display vital data such as ECG, SpO2, and respiratory information on the screen that we receive with probes
